models_evaluated: offline automated glaucoma AI on smartphone-based non-mydriatic fundus camera

links.outcome: Local prospective diagnostic accuracy of glaucoma AI against specialist reference standard
links.effect: Accuracy 92.02%, sensitivity 91.36% (95%CI 85.93-95.19), specificity 94.12% (83.76-98.77) for referral-warranted glaucoma; 14 false negatives.
links.quote: The automated AI system based on fundus images achieved an overall diagnostic accuracy of 92.02%, sensitivity of 91.36% (95%CI 85.93% to 95.19%) and specificity of 94.12% (83.76% to 98.77%) for referral warranted glaucoma.

screen.reason: Prospective clinical validation of an offline smartphone-based AI fundus camera screening tool in a tertiary eye care setting evaluating diagnostic performance across glaucoma stages.
